title: The loop unit always runs the current release, and master restart goes through it
description: A stub systemctl answers for the user manager: master init writes the unit naming the install's one stable launcher, and after an upgrade publishes a new release the unrewritten unit ExecStart resolves to the new release; master restart with the unit present restarts it and starts no detached loop, stops a unit it must pass over before any detached loop, and runs detached only where no systemd user manager answers; doctor names the unit and the fix when its ExecStart resolves to an old release or to another install's, and when a loop is crash-looping on the master lock.

steps.name: The loop unit runs the current release and master restart goes through it
